''See also: [[Leilari Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Leilari is a [[High Councilor]] within an organization known as [[the Advocates]], a position that faced opposition from some members of the group. She possesses [[Aethertech]] augmentations and an [[ocular implant]] that allows her to read messages. Throughout various events, she has been associated with [[Starhammer]], noting that he once saved her life and was responsible for the death of [[Clockworker]] due to a betrayal. Leilari has experienced periods of confusion and distress, including an instance where she was found in a white robe without her wrist [[console]]. She has also spent time alone on a private luxury transport vessel located on the dark side of a dead moon, which featured life support and an emergency beacon.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Leilari utilizes synth-flesh putty to [[The mask|mask]] her facial structure. She also wears a [[gray flight suit]] for emergency situations and has [[Aethertech]] implants located in her jaw. Additionally, she wears a [[steel]] band on her left forearm that serves as a backup [[console]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Leilari is the wife of both [[Starhammer]] and [[Clockworker]]. Additionally, she was discovered in a hiding place by [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] through the use of pathfinding magic{{!}}pathfinding spells.}}
